description: This file defines the Directory class within the Todaymade\Daux\Tree namespace, implementing directory management, sorting, and navigation functionalities for a documentation tree structure.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory node in a documentation tree, capable of sorting, managing children, and navigating to index and first pages.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts child entries into buckets based on naming conventions and sorts them accordingly.

methods.name: sortBucket
methods.description: Helper function to sort a bucket of entries alphabetically.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child entry to the directory.

methods.name: removeChild
methods.description: Removes a child entry from the directory.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration object from the parent.

methods.name: getLocalIndexPage
methods.description: Returns the local index page if available.

methods.name: getIndexPage
methods.description: Returns the index page, considering inheritance if configured.

methods.name: seekFirstPage
methods.description: Recursively searches for the first available page among descendants.

methods.name: getFirstPage
methods.description: Returns the first page in the directory or its descendants.

methods.name: setFirstPage
methods.description: Sets the first page for the directory.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if the directory or its descendants contain showable content.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Exports the directory structure as an array for debugging or serialization.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a child exists at a given offset.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a child entry at a given offset.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a child entry at a given offset.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes a child entry at a given offset.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for traversing child entries.
